armchair.note: an armchair, club or wing back, rolled arms, a loose seat cushion — built as a 3D model so it is properly turned toward the room

ashtray_pack.note: an ashtray with a pack of cigarettes and a lighter beside it

backpack.note: a rucksack slumped on the floor: a lid, a front pocket with a zip, a water bottle in the side pocket, a strap trailing

ball.note: a rubber ball: red with a curved white band, a lit side and a highlight

balloons.note: a bunch of helium balloons tied with curling ribbon, bobbing against the ceiling

banner_party.note: a HAPPY BIRTHDAY banner of printed letters on a paper strip, under a swag of coloured bunting

basin.note: a basin standing out from the wall, drawn in perspective so we look down into the bowl: a white pedestal basin with a tumbler of toothbrushes and a pump bottle on the rim, a pink one, or a small basin on iron brackets with a waste pipe, a drip and grime

bath.note: the bath, drawn in perspective so we look over its lip into it: a roll-top on claw feet out in the room with a hand shower, a GOLD roll-top heaped with bubbles and a rubber duck, a panelled avocado bath with a glass screen and a kicked-in corner, a bath with its curtain drawn hanging INSIDE it, a tiled pink tub with its curtain pulled back

bath_mat.note: a bath mat flat on the floor: a shaggy gold one, a fluffy pink one, or a leopard-skin rug under the gold tub

bed_iron.note: an iron bedstead under a patchwork quilt (one with a dried stain across the pillow end)

bed_kid.note: a small cream bed with a spotted, striped or starry cover and a teddy bear sitting up against the pillow

bed_pine.note: a single pine bed under a teenager's cover: stars they stuck on themselves, stripes, a hoodie-grey plaid with a throw, a red check

bed_wood.note: a single wooden bed lengthwise to the wall: head either end, one of five covers (plain with piping, striped, quilted, checked, banded), some with a knitted throw

bin_bags.note: two tied black bin bags against the end of the counter; or one split open with rubbish on the floor

block_tower.note: wooden toy blocks with letters, numbers and little animals — a tower with a roof and one knocked over beside it, a bridge with a drum on top, or a scatter with a tipped block and a cylinder on its side

book_pile.note: a few paperbacks and a hardback in a pile

bookcase_low.note: a low bookcase: a crown, thick shelf boards with a shadow under each, a dark back, books of every height with banded spines — one leaning, a pile lying flat, an ornament, a pot plant

bookcase_tall.note: a tall library bookcase with a moulded cornice, five shelves of books of every height with a few lying flat and gaps where one was taken, a panelled cupboard base — one with a library ladder on a brass rail

boombox.note: a boombox: two speaker cones, a tape deck with a window, a row of buttons and a telescopic aerial

bottles_row.note: three bottles stood in a row: dark wine bottles or a decanter set, the labels pale

box_cardboard.note: a cardboard box on the floor: open on tins, on bottles, or flattened

boxes_stack.note: cardboard boxes stacked against the wall: taped shut with a label and a marker scrawl, or one open with clothes spilling out; a crushed corner, a handle slot

bread_bin.note: an enamel bread bin with a roll-front lid and BREAD on it

bucket_mop.note: a mop in a bucket, the head wrung out grey

cake_party.note: a birthday cake on a stand: two tiers of iced sponge, a ring of candles, a slice cut out and left on a plate

calendar_wall.note: a wall calendar: the days crossed off in red up to the 12th — and then nothing

cameos.note: a pair of silhouette cameos in oval gilt frames, the couple turned to face each other

candelabra.note: a three-branch candelabrum with a candle in each arm, the flames small and warm

canisters.note: three storage tins labelled TEA, SUGAR and COFFEE

canvases_leaning.note: a stack of framed and stretched canvases leaning against the wall, backs out, the front one turned round to show a seascape with a sail

cat_tins.note: a saucer, two opened cat-food tins licked clean and one rolled away

ceiling_flush.note: a flush ceiling dome: a metal rim, a frosted glass bowl lit from inside, a ring of dust on the lip

ceiling_paper.note: a paper lantern: ribbed, soft white, a wire cap top and bottom, hung on a cord

ceiling_pendant.note: a pendant on a twisted flex: a ceiling rose, a bulb holder and a shaded cone with a trim band and a bulb glowing under the hem

chair_child.note: a child's chair in painted wood, turned a little toward the room

chair_office.note: an office chair rolled back from the desk, swivelled toward the room

chair_wood.note: a plain wooden chair — ladder or spindle back, rush or cloth seat; sometimes a cardigan thrown over the back

champagne_stand.note: a gold ice-bucket on a stand beside the tub with a bottle of champagne in it

chandelier.note: a gold chandelier on a chain: two tiers of arms with candles, crystals hanging below

chest_drawers.note: a chest of three drawers: a lipped top, raised-panel drawers with bail pulls and a keyhole, bracket feet; the top drawer pulls out when it is searched

china_cabinet.note: a glazed china cabinet: a pediment, two glass doors over shelves of blue-and-white plates, cups and a tureen, a drawer and a panelled cupboard below on bracket feet

chopping_board.note: a chopping board leaning on the wall with an onion and a knife

clock_cuckoo.note: a chalet cuckoo clock: a shingled roof, a carved front with a little door and the bird half out, two pine-cone weights and a pendulum on chains

clock_grandfather.note: a grandfather clock: a hooded case with a pale round dial and roman numerals, a long glass door showing the brass pendulum and two weights, a plinth

clock_regulator.note: a walnut regulator clock: a pediment with a finial, a dial in an arched case, a glass door over a brass pendulum and two weights, a plinth

clock_wall.note: a round wall clock with a torus-shaded bezel, a recessed face, ticks (bold quarters), hands that cast a shadow, glass with a curved reflection, a wall shadow and a nail (brass / white kitchen / black school)

clothes_pile.note: clothes dropped where they were taken off: jeans, a shirt with one sleeve flung out, a sock

clothes_rail.note: a freestanding chrome clothes rail on castors: wire hangers, four garments (shirt, dress, coat, jumper, trousers by variant), each lit, creased and outlined against the next

coffee_table.note: the low table in front of the sofa: a walnut one with a lower shelf of magazines (cosy), a teak kidney table on splayed brass legs (mid), a pallet on cinder blocks (squat), a round mahogany tea table (parlour), a strapped travelling trunk (lodge)

computer_crt.note: an early desktop computer: a deep CRT monitor with a green phosphor glow, a keyboard in front and the beige base box under it

crate_bedside.note: a slatted wooden crate stood on end for a bedside table: planks with gaps, corner posts, nail heads, a rope hole, a stencilled mark

crate_cubes.note: four milk crates stacked two by two on their sides, each stuffed with paperbacks and vinyl — a squatter's bookshelf

crate_veg.note: a slatted wooden crate of potatoes, onions and a cabbage, a sack of flour beside it

desk_crt.note: a pine desk: a lit top edge, a dark kneehole with a pencil drawer, a pedestal of two raised-panel drawers at each end with brass knobs, a plinth, a sticker and a scratched doodle (it wants its chair)

desk_study.note: the study's desk with its chair behind it: a mahogany partners desk with a green leather top and a swivel leather chair (den), a grey steel desk with a laminate top and an office chair (office), a small walnut writing desk (library), a steel trestle for the transmitters (radio), a long splashed bench (studio)

dollhouse_table.note: a dolls' house on a low pine table: two storeys open at the front — kitchen, bedroom, bath, and one dark room with a small pale doll standing in it

dresser_welsh.note: a Welsh dresser: three shelves of blue-and-white plates, jugs and cups under a pediment, two drawers over a cupboard below

dressing_table.note: a dressing table: a swivel mirror on turned posts (one is cracked), a lace doily on the top, two drawers with brass pulls, turned feet

anchors.name: dressing_table
anchors.note: the jewellery box on the top

anchors.name: dressing_table
anchors.note: the jewellery box on the top

anchors.name: dressing_table
anchors.note: the jewellery box on the top

drip_stand.note: an IV drip stand on a five-star castor base: chrome pole, a bag with a fluid level and a label, a drip chamber that still drips, a looped line

easel.note: a wooden A-frame easel with a canvas on it — a half-finished portrait, a seascape with a sail, or a blank canvas — and a tray of tubes

filing_cabinet.note: a steel filing cabinet of three drawers with label holders and recessed handles; the top drawer pulls out when searched

fireplace.note: a hearth: a stone (or brick) surround, a timber mantel, a dark firebox with a grate, logs and a heap of embers, a hearth slab in front; the chimney breast runs up to the ceiling

floor_stain.note: a dried stain on the boards: an irregular tide-line with a darker rim, a paler middle and a few spots

frame_family.note: a framed family photo at the seaside: a mat, an oak moulding, a glint on the glass, three figures, a gull

fridge_tall.note: a tall fridge-freezer: a rounded 50s cream one with a chrome handle and magnets, a mint one, a plain white one — or one left open with the milk gone off; the door swings open when searched

fruit_bowl.note: a wooden bowl of fruit — or of what is left of it

gifts_pile.note: three wrapped presents on the floor, one on top of the other two, ribbons and bows, a gift tag hanging off the nearest

globe.note: a globe on a wooden stand: tilted on its brass meridian, blue seas and pale continents (or a yellowed old one)

guitar_stand.note: an acoustic guitar upright on an A-frame floor stand against the wall: the waisted body, the sound hole, the neck and the head with its tuners

hairbrush.note: a hairbrush lying bristles up, a few hairs caught in it

height_chart.note: a growth chart: a thin tape of notches, pencilled marks with the age beside each, older marks faded, her name on a tab at the top

jewel_box.note: a jewellery box, lid thrown back with a quilted lining and a little oval mirror, a necklace trailing over the front

kettle.note: a kettle with a spout and a bakelite handle

lamp_banker.note: a banker's lamp: a brass stem and base under a long green glass shade, the light pooling on the leather

lamp_floor.note: a standard lamp on a round foot: a slender stem with a brass collar and a pleated drum shade, its inside glowing

lamp_lava.note: a lava lamp — glowing wax in a tapered glass on a chrome base

lamp_table.note: a table lamp: a glazed or brass base under a drum shade, its inside glowing

larder_tall.note: a tall larder cupboard: a door over open shelves of tins, jars and packets

laundry_basket.note: a woven wicker laundry basket with a loop handle each side, clothes heaped over the rim and a sleeve hanging down the front

laundry_basket3d.note: a laundry basket by the wall: a blue plastic tub with slots, washing heaped in it; a round wicker hamper with a lid and a towel caught under it; or a white wicker one with a pink rim

light_bulb.note: a bare bulb on a frayed flex

light_dome_orange.note: a 60s orange enamel dome pendant on a flex

light_tube.note: a fluorescent batten on the ceiling

linen_cupboard.note: a cream linen cupboard with a cornice: open shelves of folded towels and spare rolls over two panelled doors, bun feet; the right-hand door swings open when searched

log_basket.note: a wicker basket of split logs by the hearth: a woven rim, the cut ends of logs sticking out, a bundle of kindling

loveseat.note: a two-seat settee of the same make, for the flat that has no room for the big one

magazines.note: a drift of glossy magazines, fanned, the top one with a face on the cover

map_street.note: a large street map of the town pinned to the wall: a blue river, a grid of streets, and a scatter of coloured pins where the owner has made contact with someone

mattress_floor.note: a ticking mattress on the floor, stained and tufted, a sleeping bag half unzipped across it (or just the bare mattress)

med_trolley.note: a two-tier steel medicine trolley on castors: an enamel basin, a stack of towels, bottles on the top tray; a first-aid box and a folded blanket below

microwave.note: a microwave oven: a glass door with a dark window, a display and a handle

mirror_bath.note: the mirror over the basin: a mirrored medicine cabinet with its door swung open on bottles (classic), a cracked round one (avocado), a gilt-framed one with ornate corners (gilded), a cracked mirror tile (wetroom), a round one in a pink frame

mirror_wall.note: an arched wall mirror: a moulded frame with a gilt inner line and a small crest, glass that reflects the room, silvering going at the corners, hung from a nail

mop_bucket3d.note: a round red mop bucket standing a little out from the wall: grey water inside, the mop head sunk in it and its handle leant back against the wall, a wire handle

mugs.note: two mugs and a jar of spoons

newspaper_stacks.note: tied bundles of old newspapers stacked against the wall, stepped, the string cutting into the edges

nightstand_wood.note: a bedside table: a lipped top, one panelled drawer with a brass pull, an open shelf with a book, turned feet

note_bills.note: a reminder stuck up where it cannot be missed: PAY GAS BILL

note_cat_food.note: a note for whoever feeds the cat: CAT FOOD, TUES

note_milk_eggs.note: two sticky notes: MILK and EGGS

note_rent.note: RENT DUE FRI! taped to the wall

noticeboard.note: a cork board pinned over with snapshots and notes in a hand: CALL MOM, VET — or TAX DUE!, PAY, CALL BACK MON

paint_shelf.note: a pine shelving unit of paint tins, jars of brushes, bottles of turps and tubes — rows of labelled tins with drips of colour down the sides

papers_pile.note: a pile of papers and a folder: squared off on a tidy desk, slid and fanned on a messy one

party_hats.note: paper party hats, striped and tilted, with a few left on their sides

pedal_bin.note: a pedal bin with a swing lid

perfume_set.note: perfume bottles on a little gilt tray

photo_small.note: a framed photograph standing on a surface: two people and a child in front of the sea

photo_wedding.note: a sepia wedding portrait in an oval mat: the bride in a veil and white dress, the groom in a dark suit

piano_upright.note: an upright piano: a panelled case with a music desk and sheet music, a keyboard of ivory and black keys, a candle bracket each side, pedals; the stool is a separate piece

picture_crayon.note: a crayon drawing in a cheap white frame

picture_landscape.note: a painted landscape in a frame: hills, or the sea with a sailing boat

picture_portrait.note: a portrait someone actually sat for

pill_bottles.note: an amber pill bottle with a label and a white cap, one lying on its side, tablets spilled

pill_cabinet.note: a small dark cabinet, two panelled drawers with brass pulls, its top crowded with pill bottles and a tin of dressings

pizza_boxes.note: three flat pizza boxes, grease through the lids, one askew

place_settings.note: three places laid: a plate, a knife and a fork either side — or the plates left with a meal half eaten and a toppled glass

plant_pot.note: a houseplant in a terracotta pot: a rubber plant with broad ribbed leaves, a feathery fern, or one nobody watered — drooping brown leaves, dry soil, a cracked pot and a fallen leaf

portraits_row.note: three gilt-framed oil portraits hung in a row: a lady in a high collar, a man in a hat and a bearded gentleman, their eyes following the table

poster_film.note: a horror film one-sheet, torn at the corner

poster_gig.note: a gig poster: a guitar on a sunburst

poster_map.note: a roller map of the world on its rods

pouf.note: a round leather pouf: a seam round the middle, a button and a worn patch where somebody sits

print_hunting.note: a framed hunting print: a dark green glen, a stag on the ridge, hounds below

printer_stand.note: a printer on a wire stand: a beige dot-matrix with a fan of paper feeding out and a spill of printouts on the floor

radio_gear.note: an amateur radio station on the table: a long transmitter with a row of dials and amber lights, a smaller receiver with a speaker grille, a coiled lead and a telescopic aerial

rag_doll.note: a rag doll slumped on the floor: yarn hair in braids with ribbons, button eyes, a stitched smile, rosy cheeks, a dress and apron, one arm up and one down, striped stockings, black shoes

range_recess.note: a brick chimney recess with a mantel beam and copper pans on a rail, and an enamel range cooker in it (green / cream / black), the oven doors dropping open when searched

record_player.note: a record player in a teak case: the lid up, a black record on the turntable and the tonearm over it

rocking_horse.note: a rocking horse on its curved rockers: painted white, grey or brown — one in four is bloodied, as if a child had been taken off it in a hurry

rug_large.note: a big woven rug under the sofa group: border bands, lozenges, a medallion, fringe; or a shaggy gold sixties one

rug_oblong.note: a woven rug on the floor — border bands, a field of lozenges, a medallion, fringe at both ends, worn in the middle

sampler_home.note: a cross-stitched HOME in a walnut frame: stitched letters, a heart, a border of little flowers

shelf_jars.note: a plank shelf on brackets with jars, tins and a bag of flour

shelving_open.note: mid-century open shelving: a teak frame with three open shelves — books, an orange vase and a bust, a rack of vinyl records — over a closed cupboard on tapered legs

shoes_pair.note: a pair of leather shoes, laces undone — one of them sometimes kicked over, sole up

shower_walkin.note: a walk-in shower standing out into the room: a tiled back wall with its head and riser, a tray coming out with its drain and two bottles, a glass side screen in perspective — soap on a ledge, black mould along the tray

side_table.note: a small side table to stand a lamp on: a round pedestal one, or a square one with a drawer and a shelf

sideboard.note: a long sideboard on tapered legs: a cupboard each end and three drawers between, brass pulls, a lipped top; the right-hand door swings open when searched

sink_butler.note: a deep white butler sink on a brick-and-pine base with a brass swan-neck tap and a slatted wooden drainer

sketches_wall.note: sheets of paper pinned to the plaster: a line drawing of a sailing boat, a watercolour of tulips in a blue vase, and a row of paint tubes hung below on a string

slippers.note: a pair of slippers with a fleece trim, side by side by the bed

sofa.note: a three-seat sofa built as a 3D model (arms, back, three seat + back cushions, turned feet): gold / rust / olive, orange / mustard / avocado, a slashed grey or denim one, floral / green velvet / burgundy, oxblood / tan leather or a tartan

stag_head.note: a stag's head on a shield plaque: the brow, the glass eyes, a spread of antlers with tines

stool_radio.note: a wooden stool against the wall with a transistor radio on it, its aerial up, a speaker grille and a tuning dial

suitcase.note: a suitcase lying on top of a wardrobe: binding, brass corners and latches, a leather handle; some are covered in travel stickers (scenery — a node up there could not be reached)

table_dining.note: the dining table with its chairs standing behind it: a lace-clothed family table with spindle chairs, a round sixties tulip table with two moulded chairs, a long bare mahogany table with high-backed chairs, a birthday table under a confetti cloth with small chairs — or a bare pine table of a shared house with three chairs that do not match

table_kitchen.note: the kitchen table of its style: a check oilcloth with a chair behind (classic), a formica dinette with two chrome chairs (retro), a pine table with a bench (country), a folding camping table (student), a trestle table loaded with shopping bags (hoarder)

tea_towel.note: a checked tea towel folded over a hook

teapot.note: a glazed teapot in a knitted cosy

tin_stack.note: a pyramid of tinned food, labels turned out

toaster.note: a two-slot toaster with the toast up

toilet.note: a close-coupled toilet standing out from the wall, drawn in perspective: the cistern and its lever, the oval seat from above — white, avocado with its lid up, a gold throne with a red velvet seat, a squalid grey one, a pink one with a black seat — a roll of paper on its holder beside it

towel_rail.note: a towel rail on the wall under the window line: a heated chrome ladder rail with two towels slung over it, or a gold stand with a plush red towel

toy_chest.note: a worn blue toy chest in true perspective: two shades of plank, paint chipped back to wood, TOYS stencilled across the front, a lid with a star and a heart sticker, toys heaped high (teddy, drum, blocks, ball, trumpet, a stocking) and the teddy's arm hanging over the rim

toy_shelf.note: a painted shelf on carved brackets: three lettered blocks, a plush bunny and a toy car

trainers.note: a pair of trainers kicked off, one on its side

trolley_drinks.note: a two-tier drinks trolley on castors: brass rails, bottles and a soda siphon on the top shelf, glasses and an ice bucket below

trolley_kitchen.note: a steel utility trolley on castors with dishes, a pan and a box of cereal on its two shelves

tv_crt.note: a small CRT television on a cabinet case with rabbit-ear aerials: a curved glass with a glare, two knobs and a speaker grille; its live picture is snow, and goes dark when it is searched

tv_wall.note: a big flat-screen on the wall: a thin bezel, the black glass with a diagonal glare, a standby light, the cable hanging down behind — its picture is the struck-TV detail: snow, flashes, a crack

typewriter.note: a manual typewriter with a sheet in the roller: a curved key bank, a round-keyed front, the carriage on top

unit_base.note: a fitted base unit in the finish of its kitchen (sage / yellow / white / pine / cream): two doors, three drawers, a drawer over a door, or a gap with a shelf; the doors / top drawer open when searched

unit_cooker.note: a freestanding cooker: knobs on a fascia, an oven door with a window and a bar handle (it drops open when searched), a hob with rings and a pot / a kettle on it

unit_sink.note: a sink unit: a steel basin set in the worktop with a drainer, a gooseneck mixer tap, a dish rack of plates, doors below (one opens on a bucket)

utensil_jar.note: a jar of wooden spoons and a whisk

vanity.note: a vanity unit standing out from the wall: a tiled upstand, a worktop slab with an avocado basin set into it, two panelled doors over a recessed plinth — one open on bleach and sponges — and a tumbler on the slab

vase_flowers.note: a glass vase of tulips or daisies on the table — or the same flowers long dead, brown heads hanging over the rim

wall_cupboards.note: wall cupboards over the run: three grey-green doors with the left one hanging open (classic), two yellow doors (retro), two cream, two white with one door missing (student), two pine (country)

wall_shelf.note: a shelf on iron brackets with a thick board: spined books and a vase of dried flowers (a), a plant, a photo frame and a few books (b)

wardrobe_mirror.note: a tall mahogany wardrobe with a pediment and finial, a panelled door and a gilt-framed mirrored door whose glass reflects the room (one is cracked)

wardrobe_small.note: a small cream-painted wardrobe with a scalloped pelmet, a stencilled star and moon on the doors, round knobs and bracket feet

wardrobe_wood.note: a tall wardrobe: built-up cornice, two raised-panel doors with escutcheons, a drawer on bracket feet; the right door opens on clothes (walnut, oak, dark, or painted sage)

washer.note: a front-loader standing out from the wall: a control panel with a soap drawer, display and dial, a chrome-bezelled porthole over the steel drum, a kick plate — with the door swung wide and the wash dragged half out onto the floor, or shut

washstand.note: a gilt washstand: a marble slab on cabriole legs with a gold basin set into it, a drawer in the apron, a perfume bottle, and a gilt trinket dish with a string of pearls spilling over its lip

waste_bin.note: a waste basket: black wire mesh or dented steel, crumpled paper heaped over the rim

wheelchair.note: a folding wheelchair, turned toward the room: spoked wheels with hand rims, casters, a sling seat and back, a blanket across the seat
